# Effortless Conversations

> > Effortless Conversations teaches language learners through Conversation Based Chunking™, a fluency-focused method developed by Lukas Van Vyve that emphasizes natural language acquisition without memorization.

The site promotes a revolutionary language learning approach that breaks away from traditional grammar-focused methods. Conversation Based Chunking™ helps learners achieve fluency by training with natural conversation patterns and chunks rather than isolated vocabulary and grammar rules.

- Lukas Van Vyve
